# MOKE FORGE

> Professional Portfolio & Website Mockup Generator

## Overview
MOKE FORGE (https://mokeforge.vercel.app/) is a modern web application designed for developers, UI/UX designers, agencies, and creators to transform website screenshots and application designs into professional portfolio mockups.

## Core Capabilities
- **Device Mockup Frames**: Realistic laptops, smartphones, tablets, browsers, and desktop monitors with 125+ customizable models.
- **Advanced Design Studio**: Drag-and-drop layer management, precision positioning, smart alignment guides, and angle customization.
- **Smart Backgrounds**: Procedural gradients, high-resolution textures, solid colors, and 50+ curated studio backgrounds.
- **Instant High-Res Export**: High-resolution PNG, JPG, and WebP downloads with custom aspect ratios, retina scaling, and transparent backgrounds.
- **No Design Software Needed**: Operates entirely in the browser without requiring Figma, Photoshop, or local software installation.

## Key Search & Use-Case Intents
- Portfolio Mockup Generator
- Website Screenshot Mockup Generator
- Laptop & Mobile Device Frame Mockup
- Developer & UI/UX Portfolio Presentation Maker
- Responsive Website Presentation Studio

## Canonical URLs
- Homepage: https://mokeforge.vercel.app/
